sections.markdown:
## C2 - Confusables and KG hints, Chapter Nine Alcohol and other drugs

FACT_ID: sec09-R01 | anchor: A02
Impairment covers alcohol drugs or both, intoxication needs point-zero-eight blood alcohol or drug-driven inability, and aggravated intoxication needs point-one-eight, three rungs of one ladder. [A02]
Why it matters: group offenses; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec09-F04 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=55]

FACT_ID: sec09-R02 | anchor: A02
Over point-zero-five evidences impairment, point-zero-eight-plus evidences intoxication, and point-one-eight-plus evidences aggravation, so each decimal jump re-names the crime. [A02]
Why it matters: group thresholds; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec09-F04 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=55]

FACT_ID: sec09-R03 | anchor: A04
Drivers under twenty-one violate from any measurable content between point-zero-two and point-zero-seven, far below the adult impairment floor, with suspension fines and longer repeat revocation. [A04]
Why it matters: group youth; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec09-F11 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=57]

FACT_ID: sec09-R04 | anchor: A03
Refusing the chemical test suspends at arraignment and can revoke after a hearing even when the underlying charge acquits, punishment fully detached from guilt. [A03]
Why it matters: group refusal; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec09-F08 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=56]

FACT_ID: sec09-R05 | anchor: A02
Liquor wine beer and cooler carry equal alcohol per standard serving with none safer, and content follows count spacing and weight rather than drink style fitness or tolerance. [A02]
Why it matters: group drinks; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec09-F06 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=55]

FACT_ID: sec09-R06 | anchor: A03
Eating before or while drinking only slows alcohol absorption somewhat without preventing impairment, and coffee, exercise, and cold showers can help keep you awake without lowering blood alcohol content, because only abstaining over time reduces blood alcohol [A03].
Why it matters: group myths; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec09-F07 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=56]

FACT_ID: sec09-R07 | anchor: A05
First-offense minimum fines step from three hundred for plain impairment through five hundred for intoxication drugs or combination to one thousand for aggravated intoxication. [A05]
Why it matters: group penalties; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec09-F13, sec09-F14, sec09-F15, sec09-F16 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=58]
